difficulty_reason: Z' -> X' x_B Y is a closed immersion; it suffices to show the image Z'' of V -> Z' is all of Z'. Both maps to the products are quasi-compact (permanence + separatedness of the blowup base change), so the quasi-compact scheme-theoretic image lemma gives Z ∩ (U x_B Y) = Z'' ∩ (U x_B Y); thus Z'' -> Z' is an isomorphism away from the exceptional divisor E; the structure sheaf of Z' has no nonzero sections supported on E (definition of strict transform), forcing the surjection O_{Z'} -> O_{Z''} to be an isomorphism.
